history.content: Should I be worried about anything before Friday?

Dana's email has the details: panel is product + engineering leads, 45 min product case, bring questions, 100 Main St 9th floor. 2. Denver trip Thursday isn't on your calendar. Southwest WN 2214 JFK→DEN, 3:40 PM Thu, Zephyr Lodge check in 3pm. Your calendar is clear Thu/Fri, so no collision, just make sure you block travel time if you want it visible. 3. Two people are waiting on you: Sarah's still asking for the updated deck, and Sam says he'll have the contract reviewed by Friday, so expect that to land before then. Nothing alarming. Want me to add the Denver flight and hotel to your calendar, or draft a quick deck note to Sarah?
